data.current_summary: Analyze a SQL query and return optimization suggestions
data.current_description: Run EXPLAIN against the resolved connection — an estimated plan; the query is not executed — parse it, and return ranked recommendations (sequential scans, nested-loop blow-ups, MySQL filesort/temp table, and on SQL Server the optimizer's missing-index statements). Costs 1 quota unit per call. Build tier (or higher) required.
data.summary_suggestion: Analyze SQL query and suggest optimizations
data.description_suggestion: Analyze a SQL query without executing it by running EXPLAIN against the resolved connection to generate an estimated execution plan. Returns ranked optimization recommendations including sequential scan detection, nested-loop inefficiencies, MySQL filesort/temp table issues, and SQL Server missing-index suggestions. Outputs an OptimizeResponse with recommendations array listing each issue with severity and suggested fix. Costs 1 quota unit per call. Build tier (or higher) required.
